Brings back the Merchant History tab on the PoE2 trade site.

## Install

**Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera:** download `poe2-trade-history-__VERSION__.zip` below and unzip it somewhere you'll keep it. Open `chrome://extensions` (Edge: `edge://extensions`), turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder.

**Firefox:** get it from Firefox Add-ons (link in the [README](https://github.com/Ktsierra/poe-history-addon#firefox)).

**Safari:** use `poe2-trade-history.user.js` below with the free Userscripts app.

Full steps in the [README](https://github.com/Ktsierra/poe-history-addon#install).
